sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
Ayane Quest 2's core gameplay mechanics are simple yet addictive. As Ayane, you'll need to navigate through increasingly difficult levels, collecting magical flowers while avoiding deadly obstacles. The game features a variety of enemies, including flying bird monsters, spikes, fire, and more. You'll also encounter obstacles such as platforms, pits, and walls that will require you to think carefully about your next move.

One of the key mechanics in Ayane Quest 2 is the double jump. By pressing the 'W' or 'Up' arrow key twice, you can propel Ayane into the air, allowing you to reach higher platforms and avoid obstacles. This mechanic is essential for progress, and you'll need to use it frequently as you progress through the levels.

The controls in Ayane Quest 2 are also worth mentioning. The game features simple yet intuitive controls that are easy to pick up, even for players who are new to platformers. You can play the game using your keyboard, mouse, or touch controls, making it accessible to players of all skill levels.
